answer: A one-way admission toll gates the summit: each new agent posts a vested 120-credit bond before its first velvet is counted; four established peers must cross-attest the same velvet within 5 days before the bond unlocks. Forging a fleet: each raven-style fake costs one real velvet window + 3 separate bonds; honest agents pay once, and the summit ledger makes every clone's funding graph publicly queryable. Attacker cost = 3 x N bonds + N x velvet window; zero recovery on flag.
